title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: Put the whistle down
hook: How many times did you blow the whistle at practice?
intro: Kids start to tune it out.
statement: A signal used less gets noticed more.
q1: Do you use your voice and hand signals instead —
q2: or keep the whistle for clear stops?
q3: What happens when you drop the whistle for a day?
t1: Every coach is different. But kids respond faster
t2: when the signal still means something.
cta: Coaches — how do you stop a drill?
ctaPrompt: Share your signal habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How many times did you blow the whistle at practice?
Every stop is a whistle. Kids start to tune it out.
A signal used less gets noticed more.
The whistle or your voice. Both can work.
How do you stop a drill? Share your habit in the comments.
